title: Visitors confirm Kennedy-UFO connection

tellings.quote: although but definitely the Kennedy and UFOs were correct and and that was a huge part of

plain: In 1996, visitors came to the Los Angeles offices of Dark Skies, a TV series about a hidden history of UFOs, and told the makers that the show's link between President Kennedy and UFOs was correct. Bryce Zabel, a writer and producer behind the show, says he was there. He names the visitors only as JC and "the captain," and tells Michels that "definitely the Kennedy and UFOs were correct," which would mean the show's fiction came close to something real.
